stem.text: The image is an electron micrograph of a typical eukaryotic cell.

stem.alt: Electron micrograph of a cell in grey scale, showing a large round nucleus.

stem.text: What can be concluded about the eukaryotic cell from the electron micrograph?

A.text: It is an animal cell because it does **not** have a cell wall.

B.text: It is an animal cell because it contains a permanent vacuole.

C.text: It is a plant cell because it contains many chloroplasts.

D.text: It is a plant cell because it contains many lysosomes.
